meta_description: A live, offline AI course from an AI training institute in Vadodara. One hour a day: a 30-day Foundation or a 60-day Full program. No coding needed.

fields.subheading: Offline and live in Vadodara, one hour a day. Take the 30-day Foundation, or the 60-day Full program with agents, RAG and voice agents.

fields.heading: How the masterclass *works*
fields.intro: Live classes in Vadodara, one hour a day. Each day ends with a task that adds to your portfolio.

steps.title: Pick your track
steps.text: Start with the 30-day Foundation, or take the 60-day Full program for agents, RAG, voice agents and deployment.

steps.title: Learn in person
steps.text: Each class has a short opener, the core idea, a live demo and hands-on practice.

steps.title: Build as you go
steps.text: You make real things from the first week: prompts, presentations, images, a website and automations.

steps.title: Show what you built
steps.text: Day 30 is Demo Day. Full-program students present an advanced project on day 60.

fields.heading: What you learn, *day by day*
fields.intro: The Foundation covers days 1 to 30. The Full program keeps going to day 60.

items.name: Haritha Nair
items.quote: Before joining Artificia, AI design felt overwhelming and complicated. The live sessions and practical projects helped me quickly build real creative skills.

items.name: Nilesh Chaudasama
items.quote: Artificia helped me discover powerful AI tools that completely changed how I work. The training was practical, structured, and easy to apply in daily professional tasks.

items.question: Do I need coding or a technical background?
items.answer: No. The masterclass is designed for beginners and non-technical learners. Most students start with zero experience and learn by doing, step by step.

items.question: Where and when are classes held?
items.answer: In person in Vadodara, one hour a day. Batch timings change, so message us on WhatsApp for the current ones.

items.question: What is the difference between the 30-day and 60-day programs?
items.answer: The 30-day Foundation covers everyday AI tools, content, websites and a capstone. The 60-day Full program adds agents, voice agents, n8n, MCP, RAG, Claude Code and local models.

items.question: Are classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Live. You learn in the room, with a live demo, hands-on practice and your questions answered on the spot.

items.question: What will I be able to do at the end?
items.answer: Use the main AI tools with confidence, make slides, images, video and a website, and present a capstone. Full-program students also build agents and automations.

items.question: Will I get a certificate?
items.answer: Yes. Foundation certificates are given on day 30, and Full-program certificates at graduation on day 60. You also keep a portfolio of the projects you built.

items.question: Does the course help with jobs or freelancing?
items.answer: It gives you skills and proof. Day 29 builds a portfolio page, a short video walkthrough and a LinkedIn post, and day 30 covers career and freelancing paths.

items.question: How do I join?
items.answer: Send the form below. We message you on WhatsApp to talk about your goals, you pick the 30-day or 60-day track, then you confirm your place.

fields.heading: Ask about the *masterclass*
fields.intro: Leave your details and we will reply on WhatsApp with timings and next steps.
